$comment: Self-tuning policy for the quality gates. scripts/auto_qa_tuner.py reads
this file plus a coverage report and proposes an adjustment; it never
applies one. A threshold that moves on its own is a threshold nobody
trusts, and a ratchet that can loosen is not a ratchet.

rationale: Raise only when the measured coverage has stayed at least `headroom`
points above the threshold across `min_observations` consecutive runs,
and then only by `step`. Headroom exists so an unrelated change is not
blocked by a line it did not touch; without it the gate tracks the
measurement exactly and every PR becomes a coverage negotiation.
`ceiling` stops the ratchet before the last few percent, which on this
codebase is defensive error handling that cannot be exercised without

review.cadence: when the tuner proposes a change in the nightly job summary
review.note: Proposals appear in the nightly run summary. Applying one is a pull request like any other.
